details: The Innovex IAS012LA is a powerful portable party speaker with 100W RMS output, dual 8-inch subwoofers and tweeters. It supports Bluetooth 5.3, TWS pairing, USB, TF card, AUX, guitar and mic inputs. Comes with two wireless microphones, remote control, FM radio and LED lights. The 12V/7AH battery gives up to 12 hours playtime. Perfect for home parties, outdoor events and karaoke.
